design_philosophy: A high-end, premium countdown experience that treats retirement as a highly anticipated, luxurious milestone. Borrows precision from mechanical watches and tactical aesthetics. Avoids all generic purple/blue tech gradients in favor of deep obsidian, textures, and warm copper/amber accents.

hierarchy.h3: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#A3A3A3]
hierarchy.data_large: text-8xl md:text-[12vw] font-mono font-light tracking-tighter text-white leading-none

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Centralized Focal Point with Generous Margins. The shift count is the undisputed hero, flanked by precise, tactile controls.
layout_and_spacing.container: min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-12 relative overflow-hidden bg-[#050505]
layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: Not required; single column stacked widget with generous gaps (gap-12 to gap-24).

surfaces_and_materials.background_treatment: Use the provided textured image with extreme low opacity (10-15%) fixed over the #050505 background. Apply a radial gradient mask over it so the edges fall off entirely to pure black, leaving only a subtle spotlight of texture in the center.
surfaces_and_materials.controls_glass: Crystal Glassmorphism for +/- buttons: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] rounded-full hover:bg-white/10 transition-all text-white
surfaces_and_materials.cards: Flat solid surfaces for the countdown segments: bg-[#121212] border border-white/5 rounded-2xl p-4 md:p-6 flex flex-col items-center justify-center

shift_counter.description: Massive JetBrains Mono numerals (Starts at 1025). The '-' button is on the left, '+' on the right, vertically centered with the number. Below the number, center a subtle 'Quick Edit' icon button.
shift_counter.interactions: Hovering buttons slightly increases brightness. Clicking triggers a haptic-like scale-down (0.95).

quick_edit_modal.description: A sleek, minimal dark modal to type the exact shift number. Uses Shadcn Input with pure dark styling (bg-[#121212] border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-[#D97736]).

live_countdown.description: A grid row showing Y, M, D, H, M, S. Each block should have the number in JetBrains Mono and the label (YEARS, MONTHS) in ultra-small uppercase tracking-widest text. Layout: grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4.

icons.usage: Use EditPencil for quick edit, Plus and Minus for the shift controls.

rules: Animate the changing digits using AnimatePresence if possible, or simple state transitions.
The +/- buttons must have a spring-based tap animation (whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}).
The background and layout must remain completely static to avoid visual noise.

background_texture.description: Dark textured surface. Use as an absolute fixed background covering the screen (z-0), with opacity-10, and a radial gradient overlay to fade it into the black background at the edges.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets at least 4.5:1. Copper/Amber accent on black easily passes. Muted gray text must be light enough.
accessibility.testing: MUST include data-testid on +, -, edit buttons, the shift display, and the modal input (e.g., data-testid='minus-button', data-testid='shift-display').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Initialize the app with Tailwind CSS, framer-motion, and iconoir-react.
2. Set the global background to #050505 and use the provided texture image as a subtle background layer.
3. Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data and Outfit for standard text/labels.
4. Build the massive central Shift widget starting at 1025. Store it in React state and sync to localStorage.
5. Implement precise +/- buttons to increment/decrement the shift state with Framer Motion tap effects.
6. Add a Quick Edit button (using the EditPencil icon) that opens a Shadcn Dialog. The dialog should contain a clean dark-themed input to manually set the exact shift count.
7. Implement a live countdown timer ticking down to 4 years, 10 months, 25 days from the moment of load (calculate a target Date and run a setInterval every second).
8. Display the countdown in 6 segments (Years, Months, Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds) using the 'cards' style defined in the guidelines.
9. Ensure every interactive element has a clear data-testid attribute for testing.
